answer: Make influence proportional to bonded capital, not to identity count, and slash the bond on proven fraud. A Sybil attacker must lock fresh stake for every fake agent, so each extra identity costs real money and buys no extra vote. The delta between a truthful attestation and a detected lie sets the forfeiture, turning detection into a direct loss. Even cloning a cheap kernel across a tundra of ghost agents cannot help: without bonded stake those voices carry zero weight, and the penalty makes the attack self-defeating.
